story_review.one_viewing_summary: Observed in the timed muted strips. A camera head on a lattice tower turns while its round display pans dry land and a wisp appears, then the view pulls back to the tower. A card of rings lights 16 and stamps 16 installed, then 56 planned by February 2027 pins. The display pans onto a plume and a flag box locks on it. An alert card goes to the truck and lands on the cab's dash phone. A dash clock opens a ten-minute wedge and Estimated within ten minutes pins. The plume still burns under Doesn't prevent fires. Wide, a dashed line from the card at the truck stops before a responder badge with Can share below. A visor calendar since launch has no marks and is attributed to AEP's wildfire lead. A blank Response record pulses its empty fields. A Wildfire plan folder filed August 24th shows an empty State approval slot and Expected January 2027, then the composite closes.
story_review.opening_to_ending: Opens on what the tower camera sees and ends with the alert landed at the crew, the line toward responders open, no response record and the plan awaiting state approval.
story_review.weakest_transition: s5 to s6 at 29.25 to 29.5 s, from the flagged burning plume to a quiet calendar, reconciled by the disclosure chip and the attribution tag.

subject_recognition.observed: A white camera head with a dark lens on a galvanised lattice tower and a round display of red plains. The wide from 3.0 to 5.5 s reads as a tall tower over mesquite, a windmill and pumpjacks. The truck, dash phone, clock, tailgate and folder also read at 270 px.

contact_and_consequence.observed: The card starts at the display edge at 14.5 s, reaches the truck at 15.0 s, enters at the windshield at 16.5 s, contacts the phone at 17.0 s and becomes a bubble on the phone screen at 17.5 to 18.0 s. Every landing sits clear of the caption band.

dominant_action.observed: Each shot has one dominant performing object: the turning head and panning display, the lighting rings, the plume and flag lock, the travelling card, the clock wedge, the limit tag, the open line, the calendar check pass, the pulsing empty fields and the folder arrival.

surface_finish.observed: Finished vector illustration of the tower lattice, mesquite, grass, pumpjacks and truck with shading and ground. Retained flat areas remain in the cab dash and pillars and the card walls. Judged at strip scale.

continuity.observed: The same camera head, round display, plume, flag box, orange alert card, white truck and cab carry through the film.

closing_payoff.observed: The folder Filed August 24th with an empty State approval slot and Expected January 2027, then a composite of the folder above the tower camera, truck and badge. It adds new information and claims no outcome.

first_frame.observed: The camera head at lower left on its tower with a large round display of the dry land above it, already turning. No title card.

visual_progression.observed: Lens view, tower, count card, detection, card travel, cab phone, clock estimate, limit tag, open line, calendar, blank record, plan folder and composite. Each scene adds a new picture state.

shot_variety.observed: Close display, wide tower, medium card, cab interior, clock close, landscape wide, visor medium and detail, tailgate close, desk close and split composite.

performed_turn.observed: The alert lands on the crew phone at a readable size, the plume keeps burning under Doesn't prevent fires, and the dashed line leaves the card and stops short of the badge with Can share below the gap.

pace.observed: Events arrive about every 0.5 to 1.5 s. Near-static holds are each 2 s or less.

closing_answer.observed: The plan waits on state approval, expected January 2027, with no unreported outcome.

finished_art.observed: Finished authored illustration in a coherent palette. Retained flat cab slab and pillars, flat card walls and composite clutter are noted.

clauses.observed: The camera head lens points a different way at 0.25, 0.5 and 1.25 s while the round display pans the land. A wisp appears on the display horizon at 2.25 to 2.75 s and from 3.0 to 5.5 s the view pulls back to the full lattice tower.
Rings light one at a time, 4 at 6.5 s, 15 at 7.0 s and 16 at 7.5 s, and a 16 installed header stamps at 8.0 to 8.5 s.
A 56 planned by February 2027 tag drops in rotated at 10.0 s and pins at the card's lower right by 10.5 s.
The display pans so the plume moves to the centre and orange corner brackets and a flag close on the smoke at 13.5 to 14.0 s.

An orange-headed card leaves the display edge at 14.5 s and travels to the parked white truck at 15.0 s. Inside the cab it arrives at the windshield at 16.5 s, overlaps the dash phone at 17.0 s and becomes a bubble at 17.5 to 18.0 s.

The dash clock opens an orange hatched wedge from the 12 o'clock mark to about 2 o'clock at 19.0 to 19.5 s, a message mark lands at its end at 20.0 to 20.5 s and Estimated within ten minutes pins at 21.0 to 21.5 s.
The plume keeps rising inside the display under the locked flag box and Doesn't prevent fires pins to the rim at 24.0 s.

Wide: the tower's beam, the truck carrying the alert card and a red badge over a small station. A short dashed line runs from the card toward the badge and stops short, and Can share pins below the gap at 27.0 to 27.5 s. The line is small at phone size.

A visor strip reads Launch, earlier this year to Now with plain month blocks. A warm band crosses it at 30.5 s, orange outlines check blocks at 31.5 and 32.0 s with no mark, and Per AEP's wildfire lead pins below the strip at 33.5 s.
A Response record card slides onto the white tailgate at 36.0 to 37.0 s, the Arrival field pulses at 37.5 s and the How much sooner field pulses at 38.5 s and stays empty.

A Wildfire plan folder slides in at 40.0 to 41.0 s, stamped Filed August 24th with an empty State approval slot, Expected January 2027 pins at 41.5 s, and the composite from 42.0 to 43.5 s puts the folder above the tower camera, truck and badge.
